words.said: Start E7-S35: his WhatsApp replies to voice notes become one short line (got it, on it) plus a link to the full transcript
words.how: Evidence page shows voice-note replies cut to 'Got it, on it.' plus a 'Saved ✓ Full text' link line, with before/after.

words.said: I get a lot of long messages ... just give me a link
words.how: Page says the link opens the whole transcript in the Zenod app for the signed-in owner, and explains signed-out behaviour.

visual.summary: Both widths render cleanly with no sideways overflow; the punchline comes first, the before/after comparison and the reply table are readable, and no real look breach is visible.

reader.asked: He must decide whether the voice note replies are short enough, answering yes or no.
